methodology:
PT Salim Ivomas Pratama is the Indofood/Salim Group's plantation arm. Two reportable segments: Plantations (oil palm + rubber + sugarcane + cocoa + coconut + tea) and Edible Oil & Fats (downstream brands Bimoli, Palmia, Simas).

4-row breakdown of the Plantations segment:
- Sumatra core (425K ac): largest cluster including palm + rubber + small cocoa/coconut
- Kalimantan oil palm (220K ac)
- Sugarcane operations (35K ac) — South Sumatra + Sulawesi mill-supply
- Tea + specialty (24K ac) — Java tea estates + minor specialty

Per-region pricing reflects GAPKI Indonesian palm benchmarks 2024-25; Indonesian sugarcane marked at discount to global cane comps. The downstream Edible Oil & Fats segment is not a land-asset and isn't reflected in the property table.

Bookvalue split is a rough proportional allocation of the IDR 30 trillion Net PP&E (which includes both plantations and downstream brand assets). A cleaner valuation would separately mark the brand portfolio (Bimoli, Palmia) at consumer-brand multiples vs the plantation FMV here.
